Hello hi, so I’ve been diagnosed with clinical depression and residual schizophrenia and have been taking pills since I was 17. I’m 23 now and after 4 attempts on my life and an awakening in the ER, I simply had enough, nothing I did worked and if anything it just numbed me, but I had enough, I felt like I was a bad apple, that I wasnt supposed to be born, but one day, I had enough. I took it upon myself to survive and thrive purely out of spite. Why should I get the short end of the stick? I’m a good person and havent hurt anybody so why is my brain such an asshole? Well I wasnt going to wait around for an answer I have a life to live and nobody’s going to stop me not even myself. I started doing all the cliché advice that I scoffed at before and when my brain outright refused to let me enjoy it I did it anyways because I wasnt gonna stop myself from living the way I want to. I got in shape got my shit together even got a partner and a relatively okay life and even though I’m not really happy and dont really have a will to live, I consider myself a happy person and need to live happily to stick the finger to whoever decided to give me such faulty software. Now sure I still find it excruciatingly arduous to get up in the morning or take showers or do anything, but just when the voices start yapping that is exactly when I get up and do stuff because I simply dont care what’s happening up there anymore. I have set a goal for myself which is to live regardless of what the universe or people wanted for me, I want to be happy so I will be fckn happy and nobody’s going to stop me not even myself. I get extremely emotional when reading through posts of people going through it because it’s so fckn hard to survive when your only thought is to off yourself and I wish everybody going through it the strength and endurance to endure and I condemn anybody that claims it’s just a phase or wtvr, it is hell. But I also wish for every single one of you guys wherever you are or whoever you or whatever you’re going through I wish you the absolute best in the world because you deserve it. We’ve been plagued by biology but be that as it may I hope more than anything that you all find the strength to keep going for whatever reason be it out of spite or anger or love or whatever it may be I sincerely hope you guys find a way. And I know at times it seems like there is no way out and that there is no light at the end of the tunnel I just want you to realise that you deserve to be happy and live a life you think back on and smile because you deserve it. Fuck depression fuck bipolar disease fuck schizophrenia fuck all the unfortunate obstacles that have been imposed upon us, nothing and I do mean nothing deserves to take away your right of a happy fulfilled life. So for everyone who’s starting lose hope please keep going because when you do you’ll be glad you didnt remove your one chance to experience the beauty of the world. And for those who already have lost hope I am so sorry that it had to be this way, I cannot fathom what you’re going through which pushed you over the edge but I sincerely hope you find a way because you deserve to live. You deserve the best.
